title: Derivative of a difference quotient
statement: Let n, ℓ be natural numbers, v : R^n → R^ℓ, e, x ∈ R^n and d ∈ R (with the convention 0⁻¹ = 0, so for d = 0 both sides are 0), and assume v is differentiable at x and at x + d e. Then the derivative at x of z ↦ d⁻¹(v(z + d e) − v(z)) equals d⁻¹(Dv(x + d e) − Dv(x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (e x : Rn n) (d : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ v x → DifferentiableAt ℝ v (x + d • e) → fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) x = d⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e) - fderiv ℝ v x)
